title: Deploy
explain: Deploying a Java app usually means packaging it as a jar and running it with `java -jar` on a server or in a container. Configure it through environment variables so the same jar works everywhere. Set `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage` so the JVM respects the memory limit of its container.
code:
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jdk AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN ./mvnw -q package -DskipTests

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre
COPY --from=build /src/target/app-1.0.0.jar /app.jar
ENV JAVA_OPTS="-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75"
ENTRYPOINT ["sh", "-c", "java $JAVA_OPTS -jar /app.jar"]
exercise: Package a small program into a jar with a manifest and run it with `java -jar`.
tip: Don't hard-code ports or passwords. Read them from environment variables so the same jar runs in every environment.
